name: Slow N Steady Spring 2024

venue.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
venue.address: 3100 Adele H. Stamp Student Union, College Park, MD 20742

information:
This competition is a 2-day competition. **Saturday**'s competition will be held in the Charles Carroll Room and **Sunday**'s competition will be held in the Colony Ballroom. Both rooms are in the Stamp Student Union.

Please note, as this is a college venue, there must be parent/guardian supervision for minors during the competition.
